item.title: The Rookie - Czech Mate - Review: Back and Better than Ever (and yes, Chenford is back!)
item.description: Season premieres have a tough job: re-establish momentum, remind viewers why they care, and set the tone for what’s ahead. “Czech Mate” does all three, and then some. It’s one of the strongest episodes The Rookie has delivered in a long time, largely because it feels focused, connected, and confident.
